title: Drama
author: Raina Telgemeier
current_text: In 2014, Drama was banned at Chapel Hill Elementary School in Mount Pleasant, Texas, after it was claimed to be “sexually explicit”; it was removed from the elementary school’s library, while three copies remained in Chapel Hill Independent School District’s combined middle/high school library. Drama was removed from a Texas junior high school for being described as “politically, racially, or socially offensive.”

sources.quote: In 2014, Drama made the American Library Association’s top 10 list of frequently challenged books due to a ban at Chapel Hill Elementary School in Mount Pleasant, Texas.
sources.title: Case Study: Drama – Comic Book Legal Defense Fund
